values.note: Site 2 (55x45 ft, open) and site 4 (55x50 ft, semi-open) each take two families and trailers; site 3 (60x50 ft, under tall pines near the shore) has difficult trailer access for lack of turning room. Catalog lengths: sites 2 and 3 24 ft, site 4 32 ft. Site 1 (a small tent site on a poor road the FS says needs 4WD) is decommissioned. Up to 16 people per site.

note: Primitive Hiawatha NF campsites clustered at the north end of 188-acre Chicago Lake, beside an improved gravel boat ramp; a busy lake, but loons still call. Sites 2 and 4 are the ones for a trailer or motorhome. Pike and bluegill, some bass and perch; best swimming at sites 3 and 4. Reached via FH-13, CR 442, CR N-3 and 0.25 mi of FR 2422; access road is decent gravel. --Claude
